# 3D Pictures with Glasses

> An online anaglyph art gallery for viewing with red/cyan 3D glasses, also commonly called red/blue glasses.

## Gallery
- [Home](https://3dpictureswithglasses.com/): Anaglyph images and viewing information.
- [Flowers](https://3dpictureswithglasses.com/#flowers): Floral anaglyph artwork.
- [Animals](https://3dpictureswithglasses.com/#animals): Animal anaglyph artwork.
- [Places](https://3dpictureswithglasses.com/#places): Scenes and places.
- [Portraits](https://3dpictureswithglasses.com/#portraits): Portrait artwork.
- [Fantasy](https://3dpictureswithglasses.com/#fantasy): Fantasy anaglyph artwork.

## Information
- [How the artwork is made](https://3dpictureswithglasses.com/#making)
- [Viewing guidance](https://3dpictureswithglasses.com/#viewing)
- [Timeless Romance book](https://3dpictureswithglasses.com/#book)
